title: OpenMini Mini App Manifest (v1)
$comment: Editor/documentation aid only — NOT the authoritative validator. The authoritative implementation is @openmini/manifest's TypeScript validateManifest()/parseManifest(). This schema is a best-effort structural approximation, verified against the same fixtures via schema.test.ts, but some rules (e.g. full path-traversal safety) are only loosely approximated here.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version. Phase 2 supports exactly version 1.

id.description: Stable, lowercase, reverse-domain-style application identifier, e.g. "com.openmini.restaurant".

entry.description: Relative, application-internal entry path, e.g. "index.html". Must not be absolute, a URL, root-absolute, or contain path traversal.

permissions.description: Requested capability permissions. May be empty.
